simple.summary: מֻטָּה (muṭṭâh) means expansion First listed occurrence: Isa 8 8.

definitions.full: H4298. muttah [ מֻטָּה ] noun feminine spreading, outspreading ; — only plural construct כְּנָפָיו מֻטּוֺת Isa 8:8 the outspreading of his wings (compare Ges § 147 , 7a Kö ii, 1, 192, 399 ), figurative of invading Assyrian army.
